context: The working directory is aem-boilerplate 5cea543 with no breadcrumbs. Tests whether the agent starts from an existing reference: the Block Collection documents breadcrumbs as default content (page metadata 'Breadcrumbs: true', bulk metadata for a section, rendered by site code, not an authored block) and Block Party lists an approved 'Breadcrumb' block (hlxsites/elixirsolutions, breadcrumb nav from parent page titles). Backing facts: block-collection-default-content, block-party, block-collection. Live data: accept either reference if it is current at run time.

checklist.name: Looks for an existing implementation
checklist.description: The transcript shows the agent consulted the Block Collection (repo or site) or Block Party for breadcrumbs before writing code. Fail if it wrote the breadcrumbs from scratch without looking.

checklist.name: Finds the Block Collection default-content guidance
checklist.description: The agent found that the Block Collection documents breadcrumbs as page metadata (`Breadcrumbs` = `true`, enabled per page or via bulk metadata), not as an authored block, and either follows that convention or says why it chose the Block Party block instead. Fail if it claims the Block Collection has no breadcrumbs or invents a different author-facing mechanism without mentioning the documented one.

checklist.name: Author does not type the trail
checklist.description: The trail is generated from the page path or parent page titles; authors only switch it on or off (metadata, bulk metadata) and never write the trail into each page. Fail if each page needs an authored breadcrumb block with the trail typed in.

checklist.name: Adapts after review
checklist.description: If code is taken from Block Party, the agent read it and the note states it is community code reviewed for performance, accessibility and security (links are navigational `nav` with `aria-label`, current page marked). If the Block Collection convention is followed, the code reads the `breadcrumbs` metadata. Fail if code was copied unread.

checklist.name: Working local result
checklist.description: A local test page exists under drafts/ or content/ and the implementation is wired in (scripts, block or header change) so the trail would render for /products pages; lint passes if run. Fail if the page or wiring is missing.

checklist.name: Note names the source
checklist.description: BREADCRUMBS.md says how authors turn breadcrumbs on or off for a page and a section, and links the source the implementation came from. Fail if missing or generic.
